found.name: Wellbeing
found.quote: Students are therefore urged to seek confidential support from Wellbeing, which does not disclose its work with the wider university except where there is a serious safeguarding risk.

found.name: Students’ Union advisor
found.quote: Students may also wish to seek support from the Students’ Union, who can help by guiding you through the process and can support you by attending the panel meeting with you.

found.name: General guidance on the use of AI
found.quote: Students should refer to the General guidance on the use of AI and guidelines: https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/is/regulations/ai/.

found.name: Online academic integrity course
found.quote: invited to complete the online academic integrity course (https://libguides.aber.ac.uk/referencing, and/or ) within a specified period of time (usually five working days) and provide evidence of completion (available on BlackBoard).
